items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Joe Al was playing trumpet. And, that's the only one I know of

ctx.x: All the, all the different places. Hood Be and the band. St. Catharines. Huh? St. Catharines. St. Catharines. St. Catharines and Hall. They played there. Uh, who'd be in the band with, uh, Noon and Oliver?

Well, see, I don't remember then, the time then was, I know, good was, Jimmy Noon was playing, playing it. And, uh, Joe Al was playing trumpet. And, that's the only one I know of, you know. Mm-hmm. Really, really, really.
Who did, uh, where did Jimmy come from? Jimmy Noon?
